title: Vertical distance through the origin
observableEvidence: Finds the vertical distance between points in different quadrants that share an x-coordinate.
prompt: Points C(2, -5) and D(2, 7) are on a coordinate plane. What is the distance from C to D?
solutionRepresentation: The points share x-coordinate 2, so the vertical distance is |7 - (-5)| = 12 units.
solutionMethod: Subtract the y-coordinates and use absolute value for distance.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept 12 with or without the unit.

hintSteps.prompt: A vertical segment has matching x-coordinates.
hintSteps.question: Which coordinates change as you move from C to D?

review.originalityStatement: New candidate item drafted for this repository; it does not reproduce or paraphrase proprietary or contest material.

accessibilityNotes: Give both ordered pairs in text and describe the shared x-coordinate; a visual grid is optional.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: Both points have x-coordinate 2. Compare y negative 5 with y 7, then give the positive vertical distance in units.
